# Invitation Draft: Independent Privacy/Legal Specialist

**Recipient:** [Nominate only after written authority verification]

Subject: PARMAR independent Privacy/Legal review request

Please review identity-data handling, audit and tombstone retention, deletion,
backup expiry, recovery notices, closure/cancellation and support access.

Required expertise: applicable privacy and data-retention law, records
management and privacy engineering. Independence: no implementation, commercial
or reporting conflict that prevents an independent disposition.

Artifacts: `.github/approval/review-packages/privacy-legal.md` and the exact
worktree SHA-256 values under `roles.Privacy/Legal` in
`.github/approval/specialist-handoff-artifacts.json`. These are candidate
digests only; verify and rebind them to the exact reviewed commit before
submitting an approval record.

Return `APPROVED`, `REJECTED` or `NEEDS_CHANGES` with jurisdictional scope,
legal basis, retention terms, conditions, limitations and attributable evidence.
